paragraphs.quote: 「親愛的子民們，今天，是我們建立王朝的第78年紀念日，很高興各位在這裡，和我一起共同慶祝。希望大家開心！」

paragraphs: 《洛林精神》響遍佛萊特境廣大的野餐區，舞台上，征服者洛林帶領著大家齊聲哼唱，底下的妖精們齊聲歡呼，一同享受屬於妖精們的榮耀。

一群來自各地的妖精們坐在同一桌。海精靈贊蘭逃避著其他人的目光，專心吃著眼前的食物；騎著一匹靈魂馬的伊莉娜戴著頭盔，始終不下馬，顯得格格不入；興致高昂的湯瑪斯・韋克大口大口地狼吞虎嚥，比起妖精，他似乎更像隻哥布林；梅梅也逃避著其他人的視線，自顧自地享用美食；阿德看起來很疲憊，像是期望著這場晚宴盡快結束，可以到帳篷內休息；維爾法・寇斯莫斯則不斷試著和同桌的妖精們宣傳自己信仰的星界大蛇，希望有人能加入他的信仰，不過很顯然的，沒有人想要理他。
這時，一名看起來十分有威嚴的男子走上了舞台。這名中年的妖精清了清喉嚨，表示自己叫諾威爾，今天這場晚宴是他為洛林國王所策劃的，洛林先去準備休息了，有任何問題歡迎向他詢問，也希望大家可吃得開心。
不久後，用完餐，妖精們紛紛從野餐區離開，尋找附近帳篷的空位。帳篷的大小可以容納 10 名左右的成年妖精，不過有些帳篷內似乎有人正在忙碌著，因此冒險者們花了不少時間找到自己舒服的位置。而梅梅則待在野餐區，找了附近的一棵大樹，爬上去休息。

睡著前，維爾法聽見了帳篷外似乎有幾個人正在談話，談話的內容讓他感到十分好奇，好像在討論著和洛林國王有關的內容。維爾法悄悄揭開了帳篷的簾幕，看見其中一人是剛才在舞台上的諾威爾，另一人是這裡的宗教領袖，樹林之神的主教法倫，最後一人他不認識，不過從他的口中，聽起來是名醫生。三人談話的內容，聽起來像是與洛林國王之間的溝通有些隔閡，其中似乎牽涉到了某種宗教信仰。為了不被發現，維爾法躲回帳篷內，不過剛才聽見的內容，他知道自己需要一些時間消化。
一早，妖精們紛紛在不同時間清醒。
維爾法想著昨晚聽見的內容，心不在焉地走在路上，不過看見騎著靈魂馬的伊莉娜，他還是很努力想向他宣傳自己星界大蛇的宗教信仰。突然，他感受到自己身後搭上了一隻手。一回頭，昨晚看見的法倫主教正對他微笑。法倫主教表示大家的宗教信仰都很棒，我們是個大家庭，歡迎維爾法也加入。維爾法頓時腦內一陣迷糊，微笑著，便跟著法倫向前走了。伊莉娜感到有點奇異，便決定悄悄跟在後頭。

帳篷內，湯瑪斯看見一名妖精夥伴的虎口似乎受傷了，熱情地想用自己的雙手斧幫忙治療。然而其他妖精看了覺得沒有幫助，於是跑出帳篷外，去尋找醫生來治療。不久後，一名被稱為艾蒙的醫生進了帳篷。湯瑪斯看見醫生從背包內拿出了一綑材質特殊的繃帶，敷上傷者的傷口後，傷口快速地癒合了。湯瑪斯覺得神奇，偷偷地從艾蒙醫生的背包偷走了一綑繃帶。繃帶的材質看起來是從動物身上取得的，但湯瑪斯不確定是怎麼製作的。艾蒙醫生看見了，對湯瑪斯微笑，表示他如果想要，可以拿去，沒問題的。湯瑪斯很開心，拿走繃帶後便在帳篷外到處跑跳，見人便質疑別人是不是要偷走他的繃帶。
法倫帶著維爾法和跟在後頭的伊莉娜走到了野餐區，朝著一旁的樹林深處走去。在另一側樹上休息的梅梅看見了，感到好奇，便也在後面跟上。不久後，他看見昨晚同桌用餐的贊蘭似乎也來到了野餐區，似乎是在跟蹤著騎在馬上的伊莉娜。兩人結伴，在後頭看著法倫帶著的兩人到底要幹嘛。
森林深處，一個突兀的平地上圍繞著一圈的妖精們。法倫走入圈中，讓信徒們空出一個空位，給維爾法加入。看見站在後方騎在馬上的伊莉娜，法倫禮貌性地詢問他是否也要加入，信徒們則與看見維爾法時歡迎的模樣不同，面無表情地死盯著伊莉娜。伊莉娜表示沒關係，自己站在維爾法身後就好。而遠處，梅梅和贊蘭則躲在能聽見他們談話，但看不見人群的樹後默默聆聽。

圓圈內，法倫帶領著信徒們詠唱，祈禱，維爾法很快地便融入其中。一段時間後，維爾法感到身體開始發癢，有種過敏的不適感，在他身後的伊莉娜也有一樣的感覺。維爾法想站起身子，卻發現身體使不上力。信徒們觸摸維爾法的身體，給他安慰，但並沒有消除任何不適感，唯有法倫觸碰他的肩膀時，才有一股暖流流過他的身體，暫時消除那股刺癢感，但維爾法仍沒能站起身。伊莉娜的身體跨在靈魂馬上，他策馬轉頭離開，身上雖然感到不適，但仍有辦法移動身體。

梅梅和贊蘭看見從前方調頭離開的伊莉娜，便決定跟上，一探究竟。但伊莉娜騎在馬上，離開的速度還是比較快，因此一下就甩開他們兩人了。回到帳篷區，伊莉娜在詢問其他妖精後，找到了走在一起的洛林國王和諾威爾。伊莉娜向洛林國王表示剛剛在森林內看到了奇怪的宗教活動，建議洛林去看看。諾威爾試著將話題引開，有些可疑，洛林則表示他會找機會去看看。同時伊莉娜詢問了附近哪裡有河水，他想去沖洗一下身體，在諾威爾指引後，他便策馬離開。

雙手高舉著拿到的神奇繃帶，湯瑪斯感到很開心，但此時他突然覺得自己的手癢癢的，不舒服，於是他奮力將繃帶丟到地上。沒想到一旁路過的妖精看見掉在地上的繃帶，便把它拿走了。湯瑪斯跟在那名妖精身後，竟發現那名妖精帶著繃帶，走入了一個漂亮的帳篷內，而在帳篷內的似乎是剛剛看見的艾蒙醫生。醫生對於那名妖精將繃帶為他取回感到很滿意。在那名妖精離開帳篷後，湯瑪斯便跟蹤他，直到他走到人煙稀少處後，便襲擊他，把他綁到旁邊的空帳篷內拷問。
聽見隔壁傳來很大的吵鬧聲，換了個帳篷休息的阿德意興闌珊地跑來看，發現昨晚同桌用餐，長得像哥布林的妖精湯瑪斯正在拷問一名妖精。不久後，湯瑪斯發現好像也問不到什麼，便拋下那名妖精跑走了，阿德也跟了上來。兩人討論著湯瑪斯對於艾蒙醫生的疑慮。不久後，阿德覺得疲倦，便將自己傳送到遠處一棵樹旁休息。
湯瑪斯走在路上，遇見了剛從樹林深處出來一段時間的梅梅和贊蘭。梅梅和贊蘭也告訴了他剛才在樹林聽見的奇怪宗教活動。三名妖精都覺得事情不太對勁，想去找洛林國王。經過打聽，洛林國王和諾威爾似乎正在前往佛萊特境的入口處。
三名妖精朝著打聽到洛林國王的方向前行，恰巧阿德在路過的樹邊休息，便加入了他們，四名妖精一起前進。好不容易追上了洛林國王，大家訴說著艾蒙醫生和法倫主教的異狀，但諾威爾似乎一直想將話題敷衍地回答。
好不容易來到了佛萊特境的入口，妖精們看見了兩名衛兵抓著一名人類女子。人類喊著自己只是經過這裡而已，沒有別的意圖。洛林國王對妖精們解釋想確認他沒有別的意圖，畢竟人類對妖精是很有敵意的。誰知道在洛林國王說話的同時，諾威爾便快步走了上去，從腰際拿起匕首，迅速地劃破人類的喉嚨。眼看事情不對勁，妖精們紛紛拿起武器，準備和諾威爾進行對抗。
洛林國王試著和諾威爾喊話，表示不需要這樣子做，卻被諾威爾強行推倒在地。贊蘭躲在後方，極力讓自己不受到傷害。湯瑪斯、阿德和梅梅則合力將諾威爾擊潰，但倒在地上的諾威爾竟然化為一盤散沙，而湯瑪斯和阿德身上都開始有了非常不舒服的反應。

不久後，艾蒙醫生和幾名妖精來到了現場。洛林國王心情沉重，但在梅梅的詢問下，得知洛林國王對艾蒙醫生的可疑似乎也早就有了個底。艾蒙醫生在諾威爾的「屍體」旁蹲了下來，偷偷抓了一把散去的沙塵放入口袋，然後才站了起來，走向洛林國王，問了幾句話。洛林國王快速地將艾蒙醫生支開，然後在艾蒙醫生跟他的夥伴們離去後，也朝著帳篷區走回去了。阿德和湯瑪斯身上起了非常嚴重的搔癢感，感覺像是蜘蛛在他們身上爬一樣，躺在地上用力的抓都無法消除，一旁看見的贊蘭心裡也開始焦慮，懷疑自己身上是否也有蜘蛛在爬。三人慌張地扭動著身體，直到疲倦。眼看就要日落。在場唯一沒事的梅梅走出了佛萊特境外，三名恐慌的妖精也努力撐著身體，離開了這個是非之地。但是阿德和湯瑪斯隱隱約約的知道，這不適的搔癢感，恐怕會跟隨著他們一輩子。
河水內，伊莉娜脫下了包覆全身的盔甲，卻發現自己除了兩隻手掌外，全身上下的肌肉與皮膚都被啃食殆盡了，撲通撲通跳的心臟還運作著，但這一切怎麼樣都難以用科學解釋。他感到絕望，但想著自己也還沒死去，就再重新穿回護甲，朝著帳篷區回頭。
走在帳篷區，伊莉娜看見剛才跟隨著的維爾法站在一個華麗的帳篷前。維爾法向伊莉娜邀請共進晚餐，但伊莉娜感到隱隱約約的有問題，因此便離開了。但充滿好奇的他，還是躲在野餐區附近，觀察事情的發展。
走入帳篷內，維爾法加入了剛才一同繞圈的夥伴，聽著法倫主教的說明，接著便一起走出了帳篷，朝著野餐區前進。他們一人坐到一桌去，面帶微笑，朝著舞台盯著。伊莉娜從後方看著，感到可疑。

日落。法倫主教和艾蒙醫生走上了舞台，洛林國王似乎沒有在這裡。在法倫主教的說明下，他看著台下滿滿的妖精們，表示今天大家要在這裡見識一個新的宗教的誕生。他從背後拿出一把點燃的火把，艾蒙從口袋掏出一把沙子—那是剛才從諾威爾屍體處取得的沙子—丟向火內，然後火把燒向兩人的衣服。法倫主教和艾蒙醫生相擁，兩人帶領著舞台下的妖精們大聲狂喊：「艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！艾蒙、法倫、諾威爾！」吶喊聲逐漸模糊，然後融在一起，形成了類似「艾爾、法、諾爾！」的聲響，最終成了一個名字。阿爾芬諾。就像被火包圍的兩人一樣，融成了一個怪物，一個恐懼的化身，一個高大而醜陋的孽物，一個不再能被稱為妖精的存在。
怪物淒厲的嘶吼，然後邁開他的步伐，朝著森林深處跑去。信徒們也紛紛離開野餐區，跟上怪物的步伐。維爾法意識到這新的宗教，並不是他想像中的星界巨蛇，有些失落，但他突然感受到了一股內心的衝動，有個聲音，要他「跟上」。維爾法邁開腳步，朝著怪物的方向前進，那騎在馬上、穿著盔甲的妖精跟隨其後。
森林深處的一個洞穴內，怪物停了下來，跟隨著的妖精數量已經少了一些。洞穴內除了還血肉模糊的阿爾芬諾、疲憊不堪的妖精們，以及滿滿的蜘蛛外，還有一隻巨型的蜘蛛。那蜘蛛似乎有著人類的面孔。年長的容貌，難以解讀的表情，像是個老婆婆一樣。
「母親大人。」阿爾芬諾如此稱呼他。
母親大人抓起洞穴內的妖精，張口便是一吞。伊莉娜眼看不對勁，試著想逃脫。直到最後，他是最後剩下的妖精了。擋在洞口的蜘蛛們剛好露出了個縫隙，伊莉娜見機便衝了出去，頭也不回地離開了這個恐怖的洞穴。

paragraphs.quote: “My dear subjects, today marks the seventy-eighth anniversary of our dynasty’s founding. I am delighted that you are here to celebrate with me. Enjoy yourselves!”

paragraphs: “The Spirit of Lorin” rang across the vast picnic grounds of the Freit Domain. Onstage, Lorin the Conqueror led the humming while the elves below cheered and celebrated the glory of their people.

Elves from many lands shared one table. The sea elf Zanlan avoided every gaze and concentrated on his food. Irina, helmeted and mounted on a spirit horse, never dismounted and looked wholly out of place. An exuberant Thomas Wake devoured his meal so ravenously that he seemed more goblin than elf. MayMay likewise avoided everyone’s eyes and enjoyed the food alone. Ade looked exhausted and appeared to be waiting for the banquet to end so he could rest in a tent. Vayrpher Cosmos persistently preached his faith in the Astral Serpent, hoping someone at the table might join him, though no one showed the slightest interest.

An imposing middle-aged elf stepped onto the stage and cleared his throat. He introduced himself as Norvelle, explained that he had organized the banquet for King Lorin, and said the king had retired to prepare for bed. Guests could bring any questions to him, and he hoped everyone enjoyed the feast.

After the meal, the elves left the picnic grounds to find space in the nearby tents. Each could hold about ten adults, but some occupants appeared to be busy, so it took the adventurers some time to find comfortable places. MayMay remained near the picnic grounds and climbed a tree to rest.

Before falling asleep, Vayrpher heard several people talking outside about what seemed to be King Lorin. He quietly lifted the tent flap and recognized Norvelle from the stage, Fallon, bishop of the forest god, and an unfamiliar man whose words suggested he was a doctor. Their conversation hinted at difficulty communicating with King Lorin and appeared to involve some religious belief. Vayrpher withdrew before he was noticed, knowing he would need time to digest what he had heard.
The elves awoke at different times the following morning.

Distracted by the conversation from the previous night, Vayrpher wandered along until he saw Irina on the spirit horse and once more tried earnestly to spread the faith of the Astral Serpent. A hand suddenly touched his shoulder. He turned to find Bishop Fallon smiling. Fallon said every faith was wonderful, that they were all one family, and that Vayrpher was welcome to join them. Vayrpher’s thoughts instantly blurred. Smiling, he followed Fallon away. Irina found this strange and quietly followed.

In one tent, Thomas noticed an injury between a fellow elf’s thumb and forefinger and enthusiastically offered to treat it with his greataxe. The others decided that would not help and fetched a doctor instead. A physician named Elmond soon entered. Thomas watched him take an unusual roll of bandage from his bag and apply it to the wound, which healed rapidly. Fascinated, Thomas secretly stole a roll. The material appeared to come from an animal, though he could not tell how it was made. Elmond noticed, smiled, and said Thomas could keep it if he wanted. Delighted, Thomas bounded around outside, accusing everyone he met of trying to steal his bandage.

Fallon led Vayrpher and the trailing Irina through the picnic grounds and deep into the woods. MayMay saw them from his tree and followed out of curiosity. He soon noticed Zanlan, who had shared their table, apparently following Irina. The two joined forces and watched from behind to learn what Fallon intended.

Deep in the forest, a ring of elves surrounded an unnatural clearing. Fallon entered and had his followers make a place for Vayrpher. Seeing Irina still mounted at the rear, he politely invited him to join. Unlike their warm welcome for Vayrpher, the followers stared blankly at Irina. Irina declined and said he would stand behind Vayrpher. In the distance, MayMay and Zanlan listened from behind a tree close enough to hear but hidden from the circle.

Fallon led the circle in chants and prayers, and Vayrpher quickly joined in. Soon his body began to itch with an allergic discomfort; Irina felt the same. Vayrpher tried to stand but had no strength. The followers touched him reassuringly, but brought no relief. Only when Fallon touched his shoulder did warmth flow through him and briefly ease the itching, though he still could not rise. Astride his spirit horse, Irina could still move despite his discomfort and turned away.

MayMay and Zanlan followed Irina, but his mount quickly left them behind. Back among the tents, Irina asked around and found King Lorin walking with Norvelle. He reported the strange religious gathering and suggested that Lorin investigate. Norvelle suspiciously tried to change the subject, while Lorin promised to look when he could. Irina asked where he might find a river to wash himself, then followed Norvelle’s directions and rode off.

Thomas happily held the miraculous bandage overhead until his hands suddenly began to itch. He threw it down, where a passing elf picked it up. Thomas followed the elf into an ornate tent and found Dr. Elmond inside. Elmond was pleased to have the bandage returned. Once the courier left, Thomas followed him to an isolated place, attacked him, tied him up in an empty tent, and interrogated him.

Ade, who had moved to another tent to rest, listlessly investigated the commotion next door and found the goblin-like Thomas from last night interrogating an elf. Thomas soon concluded that he would learn nothing, abandoned the prisoner, and ran off. Ade followed, and the two discussed Thomas’s suspicions about Dr. Elmond. Growing tired, Ade teleported to a distant tree to rest.

Thomas encountered MayMay and Zanlan shortly after they emerged from the forest. They told him about the strange religious gathering. All three agreed something was wrong and decided to find King Lorin. They heard that he and Norvelle were heading toward the entrance of the Freit Domain.

The three followed. Passing Ade’s tree, they recruited him, and the four eventually caught up with the king. They described the troubling behavior of Dr. Elmond and Bishop Fallon, but Norvelle repeatedly tried to dismiss their concerns.

At the entrance to the Freit Domain, they found two guards holding a human woman who shouted that she was only passing through and meant no harm. King Lorin explained that they needed to verify her intentions because humans were so hostile to elves. While he spoke, Norvelle strode forward, drew a dagger, and swiftly cut the woman’s throat. Realizing the danger, the elves drew their weapons to confront him.

King Lorin shouted that this was unnecessary, but Norvelle shoved him violently to the ground. Zanlan hid behind the others and did everything possible to avoid injury. Thomas, Ade, and MayMay defeated Norvelle together, only for his fallen body to collapse into loose sand. Thomas and Ade immediately began to suffer disturbing reactions.

Dr. Elmond soon arrived with several elves. King Lorin was grave, and when MayMay questioned him, it became clear that he had long harbored suspicions about the doctor. Elmond crouched beside Norvelle’s “corpse,” secretly pocketed a handful of its sand, then rose and questioned the king. Lorin quickly sent him away and returned to the tents after Elmond and his companions departed. Ade and Thomas developed a terrible itch, as if spiders crawled over them, and no amount of desperate scratching helped. Watching them, Zanlan grew anxious and imagined spiders on himself as well. The three writhed in panic until exhaustion overcame them. As sunset approached, MayMay—the only unaffected elf—left the Freit Domain, and the other three forced themselves to follow. Ade and Thomas sensed that the tormenting itch might remain with them for life.

In the river, Irina removed the armor covering his entire body and discovered that, apart from his palms, all his skin and muscle had been eaten away. His heart still beat, though science could not possibly explain how. Despairing but not yet dead, he put the armor back on and returned toward the tents.

There Irina saw Vayrpher standing before an ornate tent. Vayrpher invited him to dinner, but Irina sensed trouble and declined. Curiosity nevertheless drew him into hiding near the picnic grounds to watch.

Inside the tent, Vayrpher joined the companions from the morning’s circle and listened to Bishop Fallon. They then walked together to the picnic grounds and each sat at a separate table, smiling and staring at the stage. Watching from behind, Irina remained suspicious.

At sunset, Bishop Fallon and Dr. Elmond took the stage. King Lorin was nowhere to be seen. Fallon faced the crowd and proclaimed that they would witness the birth of a new religion. He produced a burning torch. Elmond took the sand collected from Norvelle’s corpse and threw it into the flame, then the torch set both their clothes alight. Fallon and Elmond embraced and led the elves below in a frenzied chant: “Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle! Elmond, Fallon, Norvelle!” The words blurred and fused into “El, Fa, Nor”—and finally into one name: Alfenor. As the two figures burned, they merged into a monster: an incarnation of terror, a tall and hideous abomination that could no longer be called an elf.

The monster gave a piercing howl and ran deep into the forest. The faithful abandoned the picnic grounds and followed. Vayrpher was disappointed to realize that the new religion was not the Astral Serpent he had imagined, but then an urge rose within him and a voice commanded him to “follow.” He ran after the monster, with the armored, mounted elf close behind.

The monster stopped in a cave deep in the forest, with fewer elves still following. Inside were the raw and bleeding Alfenor, the exhausted faithful, countless spiders, and one giant spider with an apparently human face—aged, unreadable, and grandmotherly.
“The Mother,” Alfenor called her.

The Mother seized elves from the cave and swallowed them whole. Irina saw the danger and tried to escape, until at last he was the only elf remaining. A gap opened among the spiders blocking the entrance. Irina seized the opportunity, charged through, and fled the dreadful cave without looking back.
